title: Zebra dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="70" width="7" height="20" rx="3" fill="#D8D8E8"/>
  <rect x="30" y="76" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="30" y="86" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="42" y="72" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#D8D8E8"/>
  <rect x="42" y="78" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="42" y="87" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="54" y="70" width="7" height="20" rx="3" fill="#D8D8E8"/>
  <rect x="54" y="76" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="54" y="86" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="64" y="72" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#D8D8E8"/>
  <rect x="64" y="78" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <rect x="64" y="87" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <!-- hooves raised for dancing -->
  <rect x="26" y="64" width="9" height="12" rx="4" fill="#E8E8F4" transform="rotate(-30 30 70)"/>
  <rect x="68" y="62" width="9" height="12" rx="4" fill="#E8E8F4" transform="rotate(25 72 68)"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="14" fill="#E8E8F4"/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d="M30 55 Q35 62 30 69" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 54 Q43 62 38 70" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M46 53 Q51 62 46 71" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 53 Q59 62 54 71" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 54 Q67 62 62 70" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 55 Q75 62 70 69" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M65 58 Q72 48 70 38 L78 38 Q80 50 72 60 Z" fill="#E8E8F4"/>
  <path d="M69 50 Q73 44 72 38" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 55 Q70 48 69 42" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="33" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#E8E8F4"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d="M68 25 Q72 22 76 25" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 29 Q74 26 78 29" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="23" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8E8F4" transform="rotate(-15 72 23)"/>
  <ellipse cx="79" cy="22" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8E8F4" transform="rotate(10 79 22)"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="23" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#E8A0C0" transform="rotate(-15 72 23)"/>
  <ellipse cx="79" cy="22" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#E8A0C0" transform="rotate(10 79 22)"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="31" r="2.5" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <circle cx="78.8" cy="30.2" r="0.8" fill="#E8E8F4"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="87" cy="36" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#D8D8E8"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="35" r="0.8" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="35" r="0.8" fill="#3A3A5A"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M84 38 Q87 41 90 38" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M26 58 Q18 52 16 45" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M16 45 Q14 43 16 40" stroke="#3A3A5A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d="M20 30 L21 34 L25 35 L21 36 L20 40 L19 36 L15 35 L19 34 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <path d="M90 50 L91 53 L94 54 L91 55 L90 58 L89 55 L86 54 L89 53 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <path d="M10 60 L10.8 62.5 L13 63 L10.8 63.5 L10 66 L9.2 63.5 L7 63 L9.2 62.5 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d="M14 20 L14 28 M14 20 Q18 18 18 24" stroke="#88DDFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M92 26 L92 34 M92 26 Q96 24 96 30" stroke="#88DDFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
